tasks.title: List local images
tasks.instructions:
List the images cached on your local LXD server:

```bash
lxc image list
```

You should see at least one Ubuntu 24.04 image (from the previous lab). Note the fingerprint — you'll need it in the next task.
hints: lxc image list (without a remote prefix) shows local images only.
Look for the ALIAS and FINGERPRINT columns in the output.

tasks.title: Add an alias to a local image
tasks.instructions:
Find the fingerprint of your Ubuntu 24.04 image from the previous task, then add a human-readable alias:

```bash
# Get the fingerprint
FINGERPRINT=$(lxc image list --format csv -c f | head -1)

# Add an alias
lxc image alias add my-ubuntu "$FINGERPRINT"
```

Verify the alias:
```bash
lxc image list
```
You should see `my-ubuntu` in the ALIAS column.
hints: lxc image alias add <alias> <fingerprint> creates a human-readable name.
You can use the alias instead of the fingerprint when launching instances.
tasks.solution:
```bash
FINGERPRINT=$(lxc image list --format csv -c f | head -1)
lxc image alias add my-ubuntu "$FINGERPRINT"
lxc image list
```
